title: Margaret B NDE 21239
content: I was in the washroom getting ready for bed when I felt dizzy. I sat on the stool, got my face towel, ran cold water on it, and put it to my face and my neck. I thought I would feel better, but sweat started running off me as if I had poured a glass of water over my head. I knew I was in trouble. I knew I had to get help. I made it to the bathroom door, got it opened and tried to call my husband. He was sound asleep on the sofa in the living room. I tried calling his name but it sounded like a whisper to me, so I said, ‘oh God, he'll never hear me!’ But all of a sudden, he jumped up off the sofa and ran to me. I tried to tell him to just help me to the bed and the only thing I remember is saying the word ‘just.’ That's it. That one word. My husband said as I was going to the floor I told him I loved him, and then I was gone. My eyes were open. I wasn't breathing, and he couldn't find a pulse. The next thing I remember is still being in the doorway of the bathroom, watching my husband running back and forth from the bedroom to the living room. I heard everything he said, and saw everything he did. My husband tried to resuscitate me until the ambulance came. My blood pressure was low and they said I was coming back. I never saw my body, but I felt the sensation of falling when I re-entered my body. That wonderful peace which I felt was gone. It took me about two weeks before I told my husband what happened.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack Clinical death . I guess I was having a heart attack but didn't know it. It wasn't like they describe a heart attack. I had no pain in chest or arm.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes But I didn't know I was apart from my body at the time.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I felt that I was alert.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I heard my husband say, ‘Marge, don't do this to me.’ I remember thinking, ‘what did I do this time?’
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I could see, I could hear. I felt concern for him and I felt a falling sensation. I remember trying to grab hold of something to keep from falling.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Concern for my husband. All I could see was his expression.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I felt like I was sent back for a reason, but I don't know what it is yet.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Or at least I don't remember.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I'm not afraid to die.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: No When I was a child I could see things.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best was the peace that I felt. I really can't describe it other than wonderful, and that is not a strong enough word for it.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Everyone said I should share what happened. Tonight I decided to do just that.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Now I know why I can see things. Because they are there, and I was there.
